items.response:
He's clearly running a collections desk, and beagles are relentless about it. I don't have his feeding times in front of me, so I can't say if it's dinner, a walk or just a snack he thinks he's owed.
Action: None needed unless you want a reminder for his next meal or walk.

I'll compare this year's renewal with last year's; I don't have either document in front of me yet.
Action: Find the new renewal and last year's policy in your email or Drive, compare premium, coverage limits, deductibles and exclusions, and send you a short list of what changed.

My latest note says your collection day is Tuesday, with the green bin going out every week, so bins go to the curb Monday evening to be out by 7:00 am. A holiday can shift pickup, so I'd like to confirm against the city's calendar for this week.
Action: Check the City's collection calendar for this week and set a 20:00 reminder the evening before.

Sunday works: I'll put a 20:30 to 22:00 block on Sunday night for the spy series with Sam, once Leo's down. For your mom I'll keep everything sugar-free given her diabetes, and suggest a handwritten-style note since she sounded low (no gift card). I'll look for a well-reviewed Mumbai shop that delivers to Bandra.
Action: Add the Sunday block, then shortlist two Mumbai sweet shops that deliver sugar-free mithai, show prices and delivery dates, and order once you pick.

I'll check tonight's Leafs listing so you have puck drop and the channel before Leo's bedtime; I don't want to guess at the time.
Action: Look up tonight's Leafs game start time and broadcast, and send it to you.

Your Lisbon notes say December weather is mild, about 12-15 C, and the city is walkable, so think layers: a light jacket, a sweater or two, and comfortable shoes for lots of walking. I don't have a rain forecast in the notes, so I'd add a light waterproof for you and Leo and recheck the forecast a week before.
Action: Pull the full 'Dec 2026 holiday - options' note for anything else relevant, then draft a layered packing list for the family.

Booking East End Plumbing for Monday morning and setting your Lattice reminders. The self-review is due Fri 10 Jul, so I'll nudge you to start next week and again the week of. Your 'Instant Payouts: wins record' note already has the launch results ready to pull from.
Action: Book East End Plumbing for Mon 29 Jun, set reminders for Tue 30 Jun and Mon 6 Jul to work on the review, and link the wins record in both.

Sorry, a tap you can't shut off is miserable. In the meantime, closing the inside valve that feeds that tap should stop the drip, if you can reach it. I'll find plumbers who can come today or Monday.
Action: Search nearby plumbers for same-day or Monday openings and send you the top options with reviews and call-out fees.

Added 'get passport photos for Leo' to your to-do list. I haven't set a due date.
Action: Add the item, and set a reminder if you give me a day.

I don't have a note on how you learn Spanish best or which vocab to focus on, and I'll keep this short tonight. Tell me what you remember or I'll look.
Action: Search our earlier Spanish notes for your learning style and vocab topics, then set up a short practice for tonight.

I don't have the passport expiry dates in front of me, so I'll check Leo's first. For Lisbon, the rule I'd apply is that each passport should be valid for at least 3 months past your return on 30 Dec 2026, so roughly past 30 Mar 2027.
Action: Look in your notes and Drive for passport scans or expiry dates for all three of you, and flag any that fall short.

Here's a draft: 'Hannah, thank you so much for the shortbread! Leo ate four, so consider it a hit.' Warm and short.
Action: Send it to Hannah when you say go.

Here's a doctor's visit starter list in your format:

| Spanish | English | Example sentence |
|---|---|---|
| la cita | appointment | Tengo una cita con el médico a las tres. |
| el dolor | pain | Tengo dolor de cabeza. |
| la fiebre | fever | Tengo fiebre desde ayer. |
| la receta | prescription | Necesito una receta para este medicamento. |
| el seguro | insurance | ¿Aceptan mi seguro médico? |
| ¿Dónde le duele? | Where does it hurt? | Me duele aquí, en el estómago. |

From now on, Spanish vocab comes as a table.
Action: Save that table preference (Spanish, English, example sentence) for future vocab lists.

I'll put together a family-style order for the three of us from Pai on Duncan, delivered at 6, under $100. I don't have spice or allergy notes for the family, so I'll go for a mix of mild and medium dishes and show you the order before I place it.
Action: Build the order, check the all-in total with tax, delivery and tip stays under $100, and send it to you for a quick go-ahead.

Here's a draft: 'Team, the beta passed 10,000 payouts this week. Every one of those is a merchant getting paid faster because of the care you put in. Thank you, I'm proud of what you've built.'
Action: Save it as a draft for you to post tomorrow, and tweak the tone if you want it warmer or shorter.

I don't have a note of what you said helps you unwind, so I won't guess at it. If you tell me the first thing that comes to mind, I'll build tomorrow around it.
Action: Search our earlier chats for it, and if I find nothing, propose a low-effort plan for tomorrow for you to edit.

Pastel de nata comes from Lisbon, from the Belém neighbourhood, where monks at the Jerónimos Monastery first made them. Pastéis de Belém, the bakery next door, has sold them from a secret recipe since 1837. For Leo: the monks had lots of leftover egg yolks, so they baked them into custard tarts.
Action: None needed, but I can find a kid-friendly recipe if you two want to bake some.

Ha, classic Sam. Sleep well.
Action: None.

Booking Ascari Enoteca for Sat 16 Aug at 19:00, party of 5. I'll also look at Toronto-Vancouver flights for the three of you, Oct 10 to 13, and show options before anything is booked.
Action: Book the Ascari table, then search flights for Oct 10-13 for three and send you the best options.

Morning! Pulling your blocked tickets now so you can clear some before standup.
Action: List the Linear tickets assigned to you that are Blocked, with what each is waiting on and who owns the blocker, ordered by what's quickest to unblock.

March really is a liar. At least a hot coffee tastes better with snow outside.
Action: None needed.

Good question to settle before it renews. I don't have the membership fee or your spending history in front of me.
Action: Pull the last 12 months of Costco charges from the card statements, compare them to the membership fee and any rewards, and tell you whether it's worth renewing.

Happy to, but I don't have the bakery or the cake details from last time. I'll look for the receipt in your email so we can match it exactly.
Action: Search your email for the cake order or receipt, show you the bakery, size and flavour, and place the order for New Year's Eve once you confirm.

I'm not certain what day 'tomorrow' is on my end, so here's a conditional answer. If tomorrow is Fri 9 Oct, it's 23 working days before the offsite on Thu 12 Nov, not counting Thanksgiving Monday (12 Oct) as a working day, and 24 if you do.
Action: Confirm tomorrow's date and whether to include the offsite day, and I'll give you the exact count.

Looking at Air Canada, Toronto to Vancouver, for the August long weekend, aisle seats, no basic economy, priced in CAD, for just you and for you plus Leo. I'll keep the dates flexible around the Friday out and Monday or Tuesday back.
Action: Search fares, report the rough range for one and two travellers in CAD, and note anything Aeroplan can cover.

I'll book the 25-minute sync with Aisha and Diego for a morning next week, with your three agenda items in the invite: empty-state copy, loading skeleton, and who owns the Looker link. I'll also set the Hydro payment reminder.
Action: Find a shared morning slot next week, send the invite with the agenda and a Meet link, and set the Hydro reminder before the due date.

Pulling Tom's calendar for the 24th now to find when he was actually free. Private blocks may only show as busy, which is still enough for your write-up.
Action: Pull Tom's calendar for the 24th, list his free slots, and note what blocked the rest of the day.

I'll pull together next week from the family calendar, your own calendar and any school notices so you can plan around it.
Action: Check both calendars and your inbox for next week, then send you a day-by-day rundown with any conflicts flagged.

That depends on when school pickup ends and how long the drive is, and I don't have either in front of me, so I won't guess an arrival time. Friday afternoon traffic will matter a lot.
Action: Check the school's pickup time and a traffic estimate from home to Sam's parents' place, and give you a likely arrival range.

I'll request your cleaning with Dr. Lin on Wed 22 Apr, late morning, ideally around 10:30 to 11:30.
Action: Contact Dr. Lin's office for that slot, check it against your calendar, and add it once they confirm.
